name: REMIX: chinese light holder, attach to rear rack

captions.detailed: This 3D-printable part is a T-shaped mount designed to attach a bike light to a rear rack. The top horizontal bar of the T features rounded ends and includes three mounting holes: one center hole and two outer holes. The vertical section of the T extends downward to form a specialized slide-in holder with integrated latching tabs and a semi-circular thumb lever at the bottom. The back side of the mount features hexagonal recesses for securing nuts or bolt heads flush with the surface.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric T-shaped bike light mount for a rear rack in OpenSCAD. The design should feature customizable screw hole spacing (horizontal and vertical center-to-center distances), customizable hex bolt head recesses, and an integrated slide-in light holder with a flexible bottom latch and thumb handle.
captions.factory: The script defines a T-shaped base by unioning a horizontal cube with rounded cylinder ends and a vertical cube. Four hexagonal screw recesses are subtracted from the assembly using a helper module `hex_head`, which constructs hexagons from three rotated cubes combined with a cylindrical screw hole. The light holder (`clf_main`) is constructed by mirroring a `main_part` module, which uses `difference` to cut out an inner shaft, a front wall opening, and side relief slots from a solid block, and then unions the latch and handle components.
